theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiDens_ball_isoperimetric
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (U G : Set (Rn (n + 1))) (μ : Measure (Rn (n + 1))) (ν : Rn (n + 1) → Rn (n + 1)), IsOpen U → NullMeasurableSet G volume → IsGaussGreenPair U G μ ν → ∀ (x : Rn (n + 1)) (ρ d : ℝ), 0 < ρ → Metric.closedBall x ρ ⊆ U → 0 < volume (G ∩ Metric.ball x ρ) → HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ ↦ (volume (G ∩ Metric.ball x r)).toReal) d ρ → (volume (G ∩ Metric.ball x ρ)).toReal ^ ((n : ℝ) / (n + 1)) ≤ c * ((μ (Metric.ball x ρ)).toReal + d)
